messages.content: What's the lowest score in the Flappy Bird game?

function.name: game_tracker_high_score
function.description: Retrieves the highest score recorded in the specified game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game_name.description: The name of the game to get the high score for.

username.description: The username of the player. (optional) Default: 'john'

platform.description: The platform where the game was played, i.e PC, Xbox, Playstation, Mobile.

message.content:
In *Flappy Bird*, the very first time you touch the screen and lose your life, you’ll end up with **a score of 0**—that’s technically the lowest possible score anyone can achieve in the game.  

If you’re looking for historical data on how many players managed such an early exit, there isn’t a public leaderboard that tracks “lowest” scores specifically; most leaderboards focus on top/highest scores. If you’d still like me to pull the current record high‑score for reference, just let me know!
